history.details: Created TextSplitterEngine.h and TextSplitterEngine.cpp. Implemented streaming split logic with 64KB buffer, CR/LF preservation, subfolder generation, progress callback, and cancel tokens. Unit test runner passed 12/12 tests.

Created TEST_INFRA.md and tests/test_splitter.py. Automated tests verify 10,000 char split into 3,000 char chunks (4 files, exact binary identity), line boundary splitting, batch mode processing, and invalid arguments.

Built native Win32 GUI adhering to EliteSoftware guidelines: 56px Title Banner, 3D Inset WS_EX_CLIENTEDGE, 48px Chin panel RGB(224,224,224), Segoe UI typography, witty multi-line tooltips, About dialog with info icon & expander, Help dialog with '?' icon, Settings dialog, Statusbar, Toolbar, Drag & Drop, and dynamic icon sideloading.

Integrated std::thread background processing with WM_SPLIT_PROGRESS, WM_SPLIT_COMPLETE, and WM_SPLIT_ERROR message handlers. Implemented append-only logging to %SystemDrive%\EliteSoftware\Logs\FileSplitter.log and Notepad log viewer link.

Created Scripts/01_PrepareEnvironment.ps1 through Scripts/05_PackageOutput.ps1 and master Build.ps1 orchestrator. Produced 64-bit (BuildOutput/) and 32-bit (BuildOutputx86/) Windows Vista+ binaries. Configured .gitignore, initialized local Git repository, created initial v1.2.0.0 commit, wrote README.md, and created Agent-Thread_HTML dashboard.
